enginesTitle: We check the AI engines your buyers actually use

howBody: Nothing is hidden. This is exactly what happens after you enter your website.
step1Body: Type your domain above. Missing something? The form will tell you exactly what to add, no guessing.
step2Title: 2. We ask AI what buyers ask
step2Body: We run real buyer questions on the 3 models in your plan, and record who gets mentioned and cited. Copilot, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Naver AI Briefing are included only if you add them. Enterprise includes all 39 models.
step3Body: You get a clear list: pages to improve, mentions to win, and competitors to beat, in order of what to do first.
featuresTitle: What you get in every report
featuresBody: Every item below answers one question, so you always know what to do next.
f1Body: See if AI names your brand at all. If you are missing, we show which competitor was named instead.
f2Body: One score out of 100 for how visible you are in AI answers, tracked daily so you can see progress.
f3Body: See the exact pages AI cites. If AI cites others and not you, we show the page you need to create or fix.
f4Body: Compare your mentions, citations and score side by side with the brands AI recommends instead of you.
f5Body: Track the exact questions your buyers ask, by country, topic and buying intent, and watch answers change.
f6Body: No vague advice. Each gap comes with the next action to take, ordered by what will help first.
needTitle: Before you start: what you need
need1: Your website domain (required). Without it, we cannot run your check. The form above will remind you.
need2: Your brand name as customers spell it (required at sign-up).
need3: 2-3 competitors (optional). Skip this and we will suggest competitors for you to confirm.
q1: What happens when I choose a plan?
a1: You get 7 days on the plan you choose. Each day we run the number of prompts you set, on the models in that plan. After 7 days that plan is billed. There is no free plan.
q2: Which AI engines do you check?
a2: Lite, Standard, and Premium each include 3 models: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Copilot, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Naver AI Briefing are paid add-ons. Enterprise includes all 39 models. If an included model returns no answer, your report says so clearly.
q3: I entered my website but nothing happened. What should I do?
a3: Check the message under the form. It tells you exactly what is missing. Most often the domain is empty or incomplete: enter a full domain like yourcompany.com, then press the check button again.
q4: Do I need a credit card to start?
a4: Choose a plan to start. The first 7 days are a trial of that plan. After 7 days that plan is billed. We are not charging cards yet, and we will ask for payment before anything is charged.

pricingTitle: Simple pricing that grows with your brand
pricingBody: Choose Lite, Standard, Premium, or Enterprise. The first 7 days are a trial of that plan. After 7 days that plan is billed. Set how many prompts to run each day. The number cannot pass the plan maximum.
enterpriseChoose: This plan can use every model. We run the ones that are ready today. Tell us if you need one that is not ready yet.
addonModels: Paid add-ons: Copilot, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Naver AI Briefing
promptRunHelp: This plan allows up to {max}. We save this number and run that many prompts each day on the models in this plan.
promptRunError: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
extraModelsNote: These 3 plans include 3 models. Add Copilot, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini, Google AI Mode, or Naver AI Briefing. Choose Enterprise to pick from all 39 models.
pricingNote: Prices are in USD, before tax. Lite, Standard, and Premium each include 3 models. Enterprise includes all 39 models. Naver AI Briefing is a paid add-on on Lite, Standard, and Premium. Yearly prices are the monthly rate when you pay for the full year. On Standard and Premium, 100 extra prompts cost $99 a month, or $1,020 for the year. Lite cannot add extra prompts. Each month, Google AI Mode or Gemini is $9 on Lite, $59 on Standard, and $149 on Premium. Claude Sonnet 4 is $29 on Lite, $109 on Standard, and $439 on Premium. Paid for the year, those add-ons total $93, $610, and $1,540 for Google AI Mode or Gemini, and $300, $1,100, and $4,400 for Claude Sonnet 4. You can change or cancel a plan at any time, and your history stays in place.
